description:
(click the banner to download)

SVC adds wild creatures you can encounter and interact with during your travels.

Requires

LunaLib

,

LazyLib

,

GraphicsLib

,

MagicLib

and

Advanced Gunnery Control

Supplementary hatchery mod:

https://github.com/Tecrys/svc_hatchery/releases/tag/0.9.1

Features

Can be added (but not removed) to an existing save if Nexerilin is activated.

a variety of creatures with lots of animations

quirky organic weapons

exploration focused gameplay

make friends among the stars or exploit them for their [REDACTED]

Fully supported mods:

Nexerelin

,

Starship Legends

,

Substance Abuse

,

Take No Prisoners

,

Combat Chatter

,

Experimental Hullmods

,

Progressive S-Mods

,

Automated Commands

,

More Military Missions

Graphics, animation, sound and some writing: Tecrys

Co-Author, Coder and Writer: Jannes aka DesperatePeter

Coding: CombustibleLemon

Read the Readme inside mod folder for additional credits.

in case you want to spoil the surprise, here are some gifs[close]Changelog0.6.2

- fixed music player crash

0.6.2

- greatly improved performance

- [REDACTED] will no longer CTD when the player uses its ship system

- fixed a bug where Claws were sometimes not mirrored properly (90% sure it's fixed)

- Phaseworm Colony is now a medium, changed stats accordingly

- biological hullmods should no longer appear on markets

- dying Void Creatures will no longer deal area damage as if exploding

- fixed faction relations for Nexerilin

- new and improved context based music player code

- improved [REDACTED] behaviour, phasecloak AI and UI

- reduced Boltzmann Brain EMP arcs

- crisis now appears in the correct intel category

- fighters will no longer spawn Mios Voidlings during the crisis event

0.6.1

- Human Teeth no longer use up cargo space

- readjusted whale oil price to 1500

- Voidling spawns during [REDACTED] should be more reasonable

- additional weapon fx for [REDACTED]

- added new reward to a certain solution for the [REDACTED]

- slightly increased damage of fang cluster (~30%)

- added some confirmation checks to certain dialogue options

- Voidling Infestation no longer happens via a hullmod since it caused mod incompatibility issues

- Bugfixes: whale oil for [REDACTED] option, faction relations, using whale oil should properly reduce its stack size, ship systems not ending properly if suppressed by enemies, [REDACTED] not spawning correctly at the end of [REDACTED], Keratinos invulnerability bug

0.6.0d

- finished fleshing out the [REDACTED]

- slightly nerfed all scythe weapons (~20%)

- the penalty of Alpha Voidlings no longer applies if they are mothballed

- Hunter fleet now scale better

- fixed [REDACTED] encounter crash that happened when other mods expected a battle here

- fixed UI scaling visual issue

- fixed item check for setting up [REDACTED] (for real this time)

0.6.0c

- halved the amount of fuel gained per whale oil

- fixed unkillable Keratinos (hopefully)

- drastically reduced whale oil sale price

- Stjarwhals in player fleet now produce whale oil on a monthly basis

- Nexerilin [REDACTED] start should work properly now

- added description to Grapplers since their usage seemed unclear

- turned Pupacyst into a logistics ship being the only Voidling able to carry fuel now

- if at least friendly with Void Creatures you will be able to transfer ships from swarms to your own fleet (reputation can only be increased under special circumstances)

- fixed Lephantis ship system

- fixed some issues with faction relations

- removed some old dev dialogue options

- one of the unfinished solutions for [REDACTED] implemented

- fixed setting up the [REDACTED] after getting the [REDACTED] from [REDACTED]

0.5.0-alpha

- basic 0.97a compatibility

0.4.4-alpha

- increased Scoliac flux capacity by 50%

- fixed some decorative weapons showing up as loot

- Stjarwhals now count as "civilian" to reduce the risk of deploying them by accident

- fixed rare crash when trying to spawn whale fleet when player fleet is stationary

- fixed a crash caused by a missing zero length vector check

0.4.3-alpha

- fixed a typo that resulted in certain variants not spawning

- Parasumbilical Cord can now only deflect a maximum of 5% of target hull per second, resulting in a maximum of 20% hull damage over its duration

- Whale Event has been further improved by spawning fleets further apart

0.4.2-alpha

- fixed a crash caused by shipsystem AIs

- drastically nerved Parasumbilical Cord and Parry shipsystems

- adjusted fleet points for better combat auto-resolve

- Whale event should now last long enough for player to intervene

0.4.1-alpha

- fixed a crash due to pseudo dependency for Substance Abuse (hopefully)

0.4.0-alpha

- players no longer need the automated ships skill to recover Voidlings. There's now a different way to attain that ability

- added a new weapon

- a colony structure blueprint can now be earned

- implemented a custom Nexerilin start

- new bar events

- updated all Voidling variants

- full Exotica Technologies support including a special upgrade

- juggled many stats around

- fixed some edge case crashes

0.3.0-alpha

- Voidlings use some new tactics

- 3 new weapons (maybe 1 more)

- Voidling weapons are now obtainable

- Exotica Technologies mod integration

- Parasumbilical Cord: slight rework in the way the ability reflects damage

- 1 Miniboss: Scoliac

- Description fixes

0.2.0-alpha

- cross-mod support for Starship Legends [Big Thanks to Sundog!], Substance Abuse [Thank you PureTilt], Take No Prisoners, Combat Chatter, Experimental Hullmods, Progressive S-Mods, Automated Commands and More Military Missions [Stjarwhals are no longer a possible target]

- integration of DecoLib reducing vram footprint by almost half

- Voidlings are more dangerous now (improved manoeuvrability, removed EMP vulnerability, custom right click defensive system, erratic behaviour)

- more Voidling variants

- customized loot pool

- slightly increased spawn rates

- slightly reduced creature sound volume

- fixed whales not having fins in refit screen

0.1.2-alpha

-Fixed Voidlings not using grapplers which massively nerfed them

-fixed Nexerilin faction relations which should in turn fix the event dialog screens[close]
